author: PlayStation
description:
The wait is over! Mago: Hyperdelicious Edition is officially casting its spell on PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5! 🪄✨

Embark on a nostalgic, retro-styled 2D platformer journey as a charismatic wizard. Explore 8 vibrant, interconnected worlds filled with beautiful pixel art, unexpected mini-games, and a unique "Purification" wand mechanic that changes gameplay when you least expect it. The Hyperdelicious Edition features a brand-new level, updated mechanics, and the ultimate console experience!

✨ EXTRA DELICIOUS: THE COLLECTOR'S EDITION (PS5)
For true collectors, we are incredibly excited to announce an exclusive Physical Collector's Edition for PlayStation 5, launching alongside the digital release! 

The Collector's Edition includes:
• Physical Edition of the game
• Exclusive Game Compendium detailing Art, Easter Eggs and Game's Manual
• Beautifully Illustrated Postcard
• High-quality character Diorama to display on your shelf

Secure your physical copy soon at participating retail
title: Mago Hyperdelicious Edition - Coming Soon Trailer | PS5 Games

It Reaches is now available on PlayStation 5!

Step into the boots of Officer Jason Thompson in It Reaches, a harrowing first-person horror experience captured through the gritty lens of a police body cam. 

Trapped within the decaying walls of an abandoned hospital and its claustrophobic underground facilities, you are not alone. Something is hunting you - an entity that knows no exhaustion and feels no mercy. Stay alert as you uncover the dark mystery behind the horror that follows you, for it never stops… it reaches!
